verdict.rationale: The firm's venture practice pages explicitly cover priced equity rounds from seed through late/growth stage, with stated deal volume (~1,000 venture deals over two years, thousands per year, ranked one of five most active U.S. firms for VC/PE deals) and representative transaction types (priced rounds, convertible instruments, follow-on investments, exits). missing for 10: named/anonymized representative deal case studies with dollar amounts or stage breakdowns, and independent third-party corroboration beyond the firm's own site.
